EN: I'm taking revenge on the world!
Do not lose any more time! Dismissed!
There are no Dark Fairies here with me.  You will have to find them somewhere else.
Move along and don't break anything.
You make a rather disoriented impression.
Always remember - the way is the goal!
The Gods are always watching you, and one day they will judge your deeds.
This T-Energy can cause serious mutations if it gets into the drinking water. There are reports of people who went to bed and woke up as giant bugs.

Go to the island of the Dryads and retrieve the key to unveil the hub

How in the name of Ker did you manage to contact me? Ah well, it's irrelevant. Did you find the machine?

I see, they moved the machine. Very clever of those Temple Guardians. Well then, this pretty much determines our next step. Go to the Dryads and acquire the key. And don't waste any time. One of my spies is on the island already. Meet him for further instructions.
How strong are you without your helpers?
I have to find ten escaped slaves, punish them and return with their heads. I hope my backpack is big enough!
The soldiers who were threatening the Temple are dead. Now I can deliver the Inquisitor's message.
The enemies, who are on the rampage around here, are still too strong for me. I should come back after I gain more experience.
Who are you and what do you want from me?

Look out ... everybody stand aside! Giant falls!
I came, saw and... heh, and beat everything to death.

A town on the shores of Bluestone Lake

The guardsman said that his troops are currently shorthanded and that he has no time to deal with it. I should take care of it myself. Why am I not surprised? At least he gave me the advice to go to the tavern and to look for clues there.
What!?! Oh, thought you had gone. Pay no attention to these etchings. Nothing to see. Move along, now!
Listen, I'm a pretty patient dragon and all, but this has gone on long enough!
Do I tie the goats up? No, I let them run free!
I'll roast that lame sheep some day, and it'll taste delicious.
I have to find a new meadow to graze the sheep on. They're starting to look a bit thin.
Ah, I've found just the spot to graze the sheep on!
I am going to remove you from your saddle, your Highness...

Let's go!

I can't wait to see an Earth Elemental up close.
No, that does not interest me!
Great! Now that I have my things back, you wouldn't mind accompanying me into the realm of the Humans, would you?
You think I can't hurt you without a body? You'll be surprised!
There you are again! Well done! Lovely, juicy scorpion tails and every one of them still has a stinger! You have done well! Here is your reward!
The coast is north of here. Somewhere between the high rocks is the Sea Lion Bay.
Yeah I heard it too, but I don't know if the rumors are true. I'm usually deaf in the battle!
I thought about that as well, but I only believe in things that I've seen with my own eyes.
Isn't that just rumors? You tend to hear too much these days - and mostly negative stuff!
I won't speculate about that, but I trust our comrades to be brave.
I say let the speculators speculate! I'll believe in it when it's in front of my blade.
Don't you worry! We're paid to fight, not to spread rumors.
It's true that you think about things, but in the end we just follow our orders.
You make me think, but I'm closer to the fight of man vs. man than to any rumor.
You're just thinking too much! Our leadership is strong enough to cope with problems like that - if they even exist.
If that's the case then we should take action. For us soldiers though, the only action is obedience.
Oh, You defeated the Elemental? What great news! I will report it to my fellow Sisters. Tonight during the bingo game in the refectory. Here take these coins as a small sign of recognition!
Ker? Pfff - she can't calm storms either.
Has Ker taught you to swim, Inquisitor?
There's no room for pious hypocrites on this ship.
We'll use your robe as canvas, Inquisitor.
Thank you, you may keep everything except the little doll. I've been wanting it since I first laid eyes on... uhm, what's that weapon for?

Speak with Inquisitor Monwarion!

You have proven that you are loyal and brave, we need people like you! Go and speak with Inquisitor Monwarion. You'll find him in our headquarters' underground living quarters.
Monwarion will decide if he has any further use for you!
A location surrounded by the vast swamp region.
The Ker priest has blessed me and thus saved my soul. I'm very relieved.
Figures: Picking up items until there is no more room...
Hey you! What are you hanging around here for? I thought you were supposed to be collecting rubbish?
I am, but we're not working today. We've all gone on strike.
Gone on strike? Have you lost your mind, wench? You good-for-nothings should just get on with your work.
We only want fair pay for our work.
Pay? It just gets better and better! You already get to keep the rubbish you collect!
It's back-breaking work! All we want is justice!
Watch out for yourself! Instead of justice, you might get a taste of the blade!
That's a risk that we'll just have to take. Either that or we starve... Farewell.
Running away... I've been expecting this.
I’m an armorer actually, but there’s more gold to be made by forging plows in these peaceful times.
I've got nothing to give away.
Ointments and lotions for ladies are very popular.
You will find only the best here at my house.
People were willing to pay higher prices in the old days.
I'm looking forward to the armory end of season sale.
The hand-made buckles from the South are sold out again!
A toast to the well-lined purses of my wealthy customers!
Thanks to those brazen robbers, my deliveries are arriving later and later.
Unsuspecting travellers are the only people I would sell those Northern furs to.
Well done! My nimble fingers are still the best in the land.
There is no kind of gold that I don't like.
I guess I will have to convert this property...
The gates and the windows are open, let's get to work!
We're off to make some new distributions of property.

I'm not scared. My legs always shake like this.
We'll show mercy and let him live.
It's like I always say, nobody wants to get their hands dirty anymore and our God doesn't approve!
Kuan has to get what Kuan demands! The blood sacrifices are a lovely tradition of our people!
I don't know what the problem is! There are plenty of sacrifices, you just have to catch them!
I know Kuan well enough! If he doesn't get excessive amounts of blood he'll just make sure that our days get a lot darker!
Without the tradition of the blood sacrifices our people will become extinct, that's my opinion! Kuan can't take a joke!
A few victims, more or less - that makes a big difference to Kuan! We need more blood for him.
We are getting weaker, that's our problem! Kuan needs his blood to be favorable toward us!
These are Kuan's words: “If you want my benediction pay for it with the blood of innocent people!” And these are wise words!
Yes, something must be done! If the blood on Kuan's altars runs dry we will lose every single battle.
Indeed! Our temples should be stained with the blood of innocent people or else we'll lose Kuan's favor!
Your save game has been manipulated. You are not allowed to trade with other users.
Just a moment! I'm busy right now.
If a tree fell down in the forest. And there was no tree.. no... the other way round... how did that go again?

Fetch water samples from the temples in the area!

Please allow me to introduce myself. My name is Halnen and I am a priest. You can't hide that you are a stranger around here. Whatever brought you here I believe it was the will of the Gods that we should meet! Just now I was asking myself the not unimportant question how to gt past the ghosts that guard the temples. You know: the temples with the wells from which I need water samples. Because the ground can only be hallowed if the water in the wells is pure. Not that it makes much of a difference to me. But let us image that - hypothetically - two undead who were about to kill each other should meet, and one of them fled to such a place in order to save his life then ... excuse me ... I don't want to bore you.
Please fetch water samples from the temple ruins for me.
I recommend a sand funeral for you.
You killed the Gar'Colossus? I wish our men were that brave, just once!
Only heroes accomplish things as you have accomplished them!
Our warriors have told us about what you did to the Gar'Colossus.
You come from beyond the wall?
They say your fight against the earth elemental was impressive.
What urgent matter brings you here?

What are we waiting for? Christmas?
It was a pleasure making your acquaintance.
It was a pleasure doing business with you.
Fine. Your memory seems to be working. I hope this will also apply when it comes to keeping your promises.
I knew we would understand each other.
Fine. I hope you lead a good life.
I'm sure that you haven't made the wrong decision.
How could that have happened? I ... feel strange!
You weakling, you call yourself a soldier?
I will not be killed by rabble!
I know how to exit in style.
Don't ever talk to me again!
Bloody demon! Return to your spehre!
Return to those woods of yours!

Stick your wings under your arms and get lost!

The Orcs may have use for something like that, but not us.
You've killed them all. It's always been you! Since you obviously don't have the courage to kill me too, I'll rebuild our house... And one of these days I'll kill you.
Tough fight, but I did it. I hope they won't come back. Oh! One of them lost something.
Oh your treeness! I am very happy to see you!
How wonderful! The wise Goddess must have sent you!
I was beginning to doubt my faith. I'm glad you've come!
How wonderful to see a blessed creature like yourself.
It is a real pleasure to run into someone as pious as yourself!
It's wonderful to see you in all of your wise splendor!
It's nice to meet someone who was personally sent by the Goddess!
A perfect example of sheer piety. How are you?
This is what I call a stroke of luck. It's an honor to have the opportunity to meet you!
Meeting you today has blessed my day. How is your health?
This cult must no longer continue to exist.
It's time for a last prayer to your fake Gods, Priest!
A warrior can show greatness through mercy. You are a great warrior!

We don't tolerate foreigners in our desert! It belongs to us alone!
All foreigners will be destroyed!
These cities... So many miserable creatures...
I do expect that the Seraphim are still worshipped in this city.
As you know, I always spoke up for lowering the taxes!
You know I've always been against our high taxes, don't you?
Let me tell you that I will fight for lower taxes for all of you!
I'm working on a revolutionary program that will help me to lower the taxes.
You can rejoice! Soon you'll have to pay less taxes!
Are you that tree-hugger who thinks she can deny us Elves the right to hunt? Well then let us show you what people like you are in for!

The Broker? He don’t live here. Whoever said so was lying through his teeth. *spits* The broker lives in Orcish Byway over to the west. *beat* But don’t tell him who told you.

Retrieve the Scroll of Devils’ Fire from the cave in the south.

Welcome to our lands, stranger. If you haven’t been here before be wary, the desert is as deadly as she is beautiful. You will always find shelter and hospitality in our tents. Sadly, you arrived in troubled times, we’re on the brink of a civil war. The King is dead and his brother, Al Sadim, is currently our provisional leader. We will have elections soon. There, the tribal leaders decide whether Al Sadim remains our King, or if the crown goes to the Prince who also claims it.
Many tribal leaders do not want the Prince to be King, but they’re afraid he will retaliate if they don’t vote for him.
If he acquires the Devil’s Fire he will seek revenge on all those who opposed him. They fear the Devil’s Fire, so we must prevent the Prince from getting it.

There is a cave far to the south, where the formula for the Devil’s Fire is kept, written on an ancient scroll. There are other treasures in this cave, but they must not be touched lest they bring doom. Would you go to this cave and retrieve the Devil’s Fire scroll? You must take them to Al Sadim, and pledge upon your honor not to touch any other parts of the treasure. This aid would be invaluable to us.
Some members of a tribe of Lizardmen have failed to return from a picnic. A Lizardman warrior has asked me to help him search for his missing brothers. He has offered to pay me, so why not?
The entrance to an old ruin is near.
I've freed Bacalio's father. At least his life has been spared.
